fields.name: stockMint
docs: The Token-2022 mint carrying the `ScaledUiAmount` extension.

fields.name: equityFeedId
docs: Pyth `Equity.US.<TICKER>/USD` — the real underlying. Only exists in
regular session, which is exactly why the haircut widens.

fields.name: tokenFeedId
docs: Pyth `Crypto.<TICKER>X/USD` — the token itself. Trades 24/7.

fields.name: liqThresholdBps
docs: Liquidation triggers at this LTV, using the conservative mark.

fields.name: liqFloorBps
docs: Never liquidate above this, even outside market hours. Hard floor.

fields.name: liquidationBonusBps
docs: Discount a liquidator gets on the seized collateral, in bps. This is the
incentive to liquidate; without it nobody would bother.

fields.name: maxConfRatioBps
docs: Above this confidence ratio the LTV starts decaying.

fields.name: confFloorBps
docs: Confidence floor applied when the equity feed is stale (`Closed`).

fields.name: maxMultiplierDeltaBps
docs: Largest multiplier change accepted as a dividend, in bps. A dividend
moves the multiplier by a fraction of a percent; a 2:1 split moves it
by 10,000 bps. Anything above this is treated as a corporate action we
do not understand and is refused rather than paid out.

fields.name: minPoolDepthUsd
docs: Minimum on-chain pool depth, in whole USD, before the asset is usable.

fields.name: marketKind
docs: Public equity vs. pre-IPO collateral. Selects the rule set; see
`MarketKind`. Immutable after listing (`set_asset_params` will not
touch it — flipping the valuation rules under live positions would
be repricing someone's collateral behind their back).

fields.name: maxValuationDivergenceBps
docs: Pre-IPO only: largest absolute divergence in bps between the sized
Pyth mark and the issuer's own published mark that `resize_line` will
accept. `validate_asset` forces 1..=1000 for PreIpo assets, so the
guard can never be switched off by leaving this at 0 where it applies.

fields.name: maxTransferFeeBps
docs: Maximum transfer-fee basis points the mint may charge, declared at
listing and checked against the mint's own TransferFeeConfig in
`add_asset` (the max of the active and scheduled epochs). Deposits
credit the vault's *measured* delta, never the requested amount, so
a fee can only ever reduce recorded collateral, never inflate debt.

fields.name: issuerControls
docs: Issuer control flags, recorded from the mint at listing. See CTRL_*.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved for future fields; keeps the Borsh layout upgrade-safe.

fields.name: usdcReserve
docs: PDA holding the USDC that backs draws.

fields.name: reserveBump
docs: Bump of the USDC reserve token account, needed to sign disbursements.

fields.name: pythReceiver
docs: Pyth pull-oracle receiver program id. `Pubkey::default()` = sandbox (keeper marks allowed).

fields.name: usdcDebt
docs: Principal outstanding, USDC minor units (6dp).

fields.name: lastSizingTs
docs: Last recomputation of the credit limit.

fields.name: collateralUsdc
docs: Total collateral value at last sizing, USDC 6dp.

fields.name: creditLimitUsdc
docs: Credit limit at last sizing, USDC 6dp.

fields.name: availableCreditUsdc
docs: `max(0, credit_limit - debt - interest)`.

fields.name: dividendsReceived
docs: Lifetime USDC harvested from dividends.

fields.name: dividendsToRepay
docs: Lifetime USDC of that which repaid debt.

fields.name: dividendsPaidOut
docs: Lifetime USDC of that which was paid to the borrower.

fields.name: eventSeq
docs: Monotonic counter for emitted events. Off-chain consumers (the demo's
activity feed) can detect a missed event — a gap in `seq` — instead
of silently missing, say, a liquidation.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved for future fields; keeps the Borsh layout upgrade-safe. One
byte less than `Asset`'s tail because `CollateralSlot` grew by the
`market_kind` byte.

fields.name: sharesBefore
docs: Fixed-point (1e9) share counts before and after the trim.

instructions.name: addAsset
docs: Register an xStock mint and its risk parameters. Admin only.
The parameters arrive as an `Asset` value and are copied into the PDA;
`stock_mint` and `bump` are taken from the accounts, not from the caller.

accounts.name: stockMint
docs: The mint being listed. Must equal `params.stock_mint`.

instructions.name: closeLine
docs: Close the line once debt is repaid and collateral withdrawn.
Returning collateral needs a vault and destination account per mint,
which does not fit a variable-length account list. The borrower
withdraws each slot first — which re-checks health — then closes.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Move xStocks into the line's vault and record the raw amount plus the
multiplier that was live at deposit time.
The multiplier is read from the mint's `ScaledUiAmount` extension in
this instruction. It is never taken from the caller: the multiplier
decides how much the deposit is worth, so accepting it as an argument
would let anyone inflate their own collateral.

instructions.name: draw
docs: Disburse USDC against the line. This is what the card terminal calls.

accounts.name: recipient
docs: Where the borrowed USDC goes — the merchant, or the borrower's wallet.

instructions.name: harvestDividend
docs: Detect a dividend and trim the vault to match. Idempotent.
The multiplier is read from the mint in this instruction, never taken on
trust. Three independent things have to line up before anything moves:
1. The `effective_ts` argument equals the mint's scheduled timestamp.
2. That timestamp has passed, and the new multiplier differs from the old.
3. The slot's recorded baseline equals the mint's current baseline, i.e.
this bump has not already been harvested.
On top of that the `DividendEvent` PDA is seeded with `effective_ts`, so
re-running the keeper for the same corporate action cannot create a
second event. A keeper that crashes mid-flight and retries is safe.
The trimmed tokens go to the protocol treasury; converting them to USDC
and applying the proceeds is a separate step so the swap route is not
baked into this instruction.

accounts.name: mint
docs: is the Token-2022 program and that the ScaledUiAmount extension is present.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Protocol-owned destination for the trimmed tokens, pending conversion.

accounts.name: dividendEvent
docs: Seeded with `effective_ts`, so one corporate action can only ever
produce one event. This is the idempotency guarantee.

instructions.name: initConfig
docs: Create the global config and the USDC reserve that backs draws.

instructions.name: liquidate
docs: Liquidate part of an unhealthy line.
No DEX is involved: the liquidator repays USDC and takes collateral at a
bonus directly from the vault. That keeps the whole operation inside one
transaction and avoids depending on pool liquidity, which is exactly what
is unreliable outside market hours.
Session-aware by construction. If the line is underwater but the market
is closed and the hard floor has not been breached, this refuses with
`LiquidationDeferred` rather than dumping collateral into a thin weekend
pool. The keeper re-evaluates at the open.
Acts on the line's most recent sizing, and refuses if that sizing is
older than `MAX_SIZING_AGE_SECS`. Liquidating against a stale mark is how
a solvent borrower gets wiped out.

accounts.name: stockDest
docs: Liquidator's account for the collateral mint.

accounts.name: usdcFrom
docs: Liquidator's USDC.

accounts.name: liquidator
docs: Permissionless: anyone may liquidate and keep the bonus.

accounts.name: tokenProgram
docs: Token program of the collateral mint.

accounts.name: usdcTokenProgram
docs: Token program of USDC. It is deliberately a second account: USDC is
a legacy SPL mint while every collateral mint is Token-2022 (that is
where the multiplier lives). One instruction cannot CPI both transfer
kinds through one program id, and `liquidate` is the only instruction
that moves both tokens at once.

instructions.name: openLine
docs: Open a credit line for the signer. One line per wallet.

instructions.name: repay
docs: Repay debt. Called by the user, or by the dividend engine on their behalf.

accounts.name: payerAuthority
docs: Either the borrower or the keeper (for an automated dividend repayment).

instructions.name: resizeLine
docs: Recompute the credit limit from the current marks and session.
Asset accounts are passed in `remaining_accounts`, one per collateral
slot, because the count varies and Anchor cannot size a variable list.
Each is validated as a genuine `Asset` of this program by its owner and
discriminator, then matched to a slot by mint.
Marks are verified against optional Pyth `PriceUpdateV2` accounts in
`remaining_accounts` when `config.pyth_receiver` is set; otherwise sandbox
mode accepts keeper marks (logged).

instructions.name: setAssetParams
docs: Update risk parameters for a listed mint. Admin only.

instructions.name: setHoliday
docs: Add or remove a market closure not already in the built-in holiday table.

instructions.name: setPythReceiver
docs: Pin the Pyth receiver for on-chain price verification (`resize_line`).
While unset (`default`), devnet may use keeper-supplied marks.

instructions.name: settleDividend
docs: Apply a harvested dividend: convert it to USDC and route it.
`harvest_dividend` moved raw tokens to the treasury and recorded exactly
what they are worth. This instruction delivers that amount in USDC and
applies it according to the borrower's payout mode.
The amount is not an argument. It is read from the `DividendEvent` the
harvest wrote, so the keeper cannot claim a larger dividend than the
on-chain arithmetic produced. Under-delivering is possible; over-crediting
a borrower is not. The event is also single-use, so it cannot be settled
twice.

accounts.name: dividendEvent
docs: The event written by `harvest_dividend`. Its `net_usd` is the amount
settled here, so it cannot be inflated.

accounts.name: usdcFrom
docs: Keeper's USDC, holding the proceeds of the swap.

accounts.name: userUsdc
docs: Borrower's USDC. Only required when the payout mode is `Payout`.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Return collateral, but only if the line stays healthy afterwards.

definedTypes.name: collateralSlot
docs: One collateral position. `raw_amount` is the on-chain token amount and is
never the UI amount — see the ScaledUiAmount finding in docs/RESEARCH.md.

fields.name: vaultAta
docs: PDA-owned token account holding this mint.

fields.name: rawAmount
docs: Raw token amount, minor units (6dp for xStocks).

fields.name: multiplierBits
docs: The mint's ScaledUiAmount multiplier at deposit time, as f64 bits.
Used to compute the dividend delta later.

fields.name: marketKind
docs: Copied from the asset when the slot was created: decides which
valuation/sizing rules this position lives under (`MarketKind`).
Stored on the slot, not read from the asset account at draw time,
because `draw` deliberately does not load per-asset accounts — the
line must stay a single-account hot path.

definedTypes.name: fixed
docs: A non-negative fixed-point number with `DP` decimals, stored as a `u128`.

definedTypes.name: marketKind
docs: Which valuation and sizing rules apply to an asset.
`PublicEquity` is every xStock: Pyth price + confidence, session-aware
LTV, dividend harvest. `PreIpo` is PreStocks collateral (OpenAI,
Anthropic, SpaceX shares): a single issuer-published mark with **no
confidence band at all**, so the protocol refuses to trust its price the
way it trusts a market feed — LTV is capped at the closed-session tier no
matter the clock, a draw requires a sizing from the last two minutes, and
the mark may not diverge from the issuer's own published mark beyond the
asset's configured cap. No dividends exist before an IPO, so harvest is
not part of this rule set — refusing it is safer than pretending.

definedTypes.name: operatingState
docs: Two-level pause, so a bad keeper or a bad feed does not force an
all-or-nothing switch. Both non-Normal states keep the *unwinding* path
open — repay, withdraw, resize, liquidate, settle — because an incident
must never trap collateral: the borrower can always get out, and the
protocol can always be made whole. `Halt` additionally freezes harvest
(it would be mutating positions against a feed nobody trusts).

definedTypes.name: payoutMode
docs: What the borrower wants done with a harvested dividend.

definedTypes.name: priceMark
docs: A price mark for one asset at one instant, in USD fixed-point (1e9).

fields.name: price
docs: USD per whole share.

fields.name: conf
docs: Absolute confidence interval, USD per whole share.

fields.name: publishTs
docs: Unix timestamp of the underlying feed update.

fields.name: dislocationBps
docs: `(token_feed / equity_feed) - 1`, in basis points. Always surfaced to the
user, even when it is large — that honesty is the point.

definedTypes.name: session
docs: Market session, derived from `Clock` + a holiday table.
The session drives the haircut: the reference equity feed does not exist outside
US market hours, so the buffer widens when the underlying market is dark.

fields.name: amount
docs: Raw token units actually received by the vault (after any transfer
fee), never the amount the sender requested.

fields.name: netUsd
docs: USDC of dividend value converted and applied (6dp).

fields.name: rawTrimmed
docs: Collateral trimmed to keep share-count parity after the multiplier bump.

fields.name: amount
docs: USDC disbursed to the borrower (6dp minor units).

fields.name: totalDebtIncrease
docs: Principal + draw fee added to debt.

fields.name: repaid
docs: USDC of debt the liquidator repaid.

fields.name: seized
docs: Collateral raw units seized (value includes the bonus).
